description: This file contains unit tests for the reftable merged table functionality, including creation, iteration, seeking, and validation of references, logs, and internal structures within the reftable project.

classes.name: reftable_merged_table
classes.description: Represents a merged reftable, supporting iteration and querying of combined references and logs.

classes.name: reftable_iterator
classes.description: Iterator used to traverse references or logs within a merged table.

methods.name: struct:reftable_merged_table * merged_table_from_records(struct reftable_ref_record ** refs,struct reftable_block_source ** source,struct reftable_table *** tables,const size_t * sizes,struct reftable_buf * buf,const size_t n)
methods.description: Creates a merged table from given reference records, source buffers, and tables.

methods.name: void tables_destroy(struct reftable_table ** tables,const size_t n)
methods.description: Decreases reference counts and frees an array of tables.

methods.name: void test_reftable_merged__single_record(void)
methods.description: Unit test for handling a single reference record in the merged table.

methods.name: void test_reftable_merged__refs(void)
methods.description: Unit test for merging multiple reference records with conflicting updates.

methods.name: void test_reftable_merged__seek_multiple_times(void)
methods.description: Tests repeated seeking and iteration over references to ensure consistent behavior.

methods.name: void test_reftable_merged__seek_multiple_times_no_drain(void)
methods.description: Tests seeking and iterating multiple times without draining internal buffers.

methods.name: struct:reftable_merged_table * merged_table_from_log_records(struct reftable_log_record ** logs,struct reftable_block_source ** source,struct reftable_table *** tables,const size_t * sizes,struct reftable_buf * buf,const size_t n)
methods.description: Creates a merged table from log records for testing log-related functionalities.

methods.name: void test_reftable_merged__logs(void)
methods.description: Unit test for handling log records in the merged table, including seeking and iteration.

methods.name: void test_reftable_merged__default_write_opts(void)
methods.description: Test default write options and creation of a table from a buffer with validation of hash ID.

ctags.name: merged_table_from_log_records
ctags.signature: (struct reftable_log_record ** logs,struct reftable_block_source ** source,struct reftable_table *** tables,const size_t * sizes,struct reftable_buf * buf,const size_t n)

ctags.name: merged_table_from_records
ctags.signature: (struct reftable_ref_record ** refs,struct reftable_block_source ** source,struct reftable_table *** tables,const size_t * sizes,struct reftable_buf * buf,const size_t n)

ctags.name: tables_destroy
ctags.pattern: /^static void tables_destroy(struct reftable_table **tables, const size_t n)$/
